Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Adon Eshar: 29-year-old woman, 175 cm (medium), soft rounded construction with an evident middle and gentle limb contours, skin value band-4-medium. Face: wide triangular face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; short rounded nose, wide mouth; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: fitted-vest-system, specifically a fitted cloth vest system over a soft shirt, high-waist trousers, and flexible boots; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
